items.label: Powerful 8-Core Performance for Smooth Productivity
items.value: Powered by the Intel i3-N305 8-core processor up to 3.8GHz, this laptop delivers responsive performance for multitasking, office work, browsing, and streaming, ensuring smooth productivity throughout your day.

items.label: 15.6" FHD Touchscreen for an Immersive Visual Experience
items.value: The 15.6" FHD anti-glare touchscreen delivers crisp, detailed visuals with natural color, while responsive touch control lets you navigate, edit, and create more intuitively for an elevated user experience.

items.label: 16GB RAM & 1TB SSD for Speed and Efficiency
items.value: Equipped with 16GB DDR4 RAM for smoother operation and seamless multitasking, along with a 1TB PCIe SSD that offers fast boot-ups, rapid app loading, and dependable storage for daily files.

items.label: Wi-Fi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3 for Fast and Stable Connectivity
items.value: Featuring advanced Wi-Fi 6 for faster speeds and lower latency, this laptop ensures smoother streaming and online meetings, while Bluetooth 5.3 delivers stable connections with wireless accessories.

items.label: Slim Design, All-Day Battery & Clear HD Webcam
items.value: Weighing just 3.52 lbs and only 0.73" thin, it’s easy to travel with and lasts up to 9.75 hours on a single charge. The 720p HD webcam with noise reduction ensures clearer, more professional video calls.
